exposure: gestational weeks on operation day: 37-38 weeks and 39 weeks
cohort: 195 patients with a history of four or more cesarean sections at a tertiary hospital
finding: Timing cesarean section at 39 weeks in patients with a history of four or more cesarean sections did not worsen maternal outcomes and may improve newborn outcomes compared to 37-38 weeks.
birth_weight: not specified, but neonatal birth weight was included in the analysis
